cases.name: etaf-md-tests-typing-keeps-the-followed-page-in-place
cases.purpose: Typing near the top of the source leaves the followed page where it was: the follow compares the line the source window starts on rather than its position, which an insertion above the window moves on every keystroke.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-fence-keeps-its-body-and-a-heading-its-text
cases.purpose: A fenced block paints its code and a heading paints its words rather than the fence line or the heading marker alone, because both keep their text in the block's own fields instead of inline children.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-heading-color-separates-from-flat-themed-ink
cases.purpose: A theme whose outline color is its body color still renders headings in a hue derived from the accent, instead of headings that read as plain text.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-heading-keeps-a-distinct-theme-color
cases.purpose: A theme whose heading color differs from its body text keeps that color, so the derivation only replaces a heading color that would read flat.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-open-prompt-defaults-to-the-relative-file
cases.purpose: Opening the preview interactively hands the file prompt a name relative to `default-directory', so the prompt shows the directory once instead of repeating it around the current buffer's file.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-help-stays-in-preview
cases.purpose: Both help entries show effective labelled bindings in the existing preview; search and layered Escape preserve the document state and window layout.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-alerts-end-with-their-body
cases.purpose: All five callout kinds preserve explicit body line breaks and end without an extra padded row, retaining one normal inter-block blank line.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-narrow-window-keeps-the-measure-gutter
cases.purpose: A window that fills the reading measure keeps its side gutters, and a table whose columns cannot fit is clipped at the measure instead of painting a border bar across the edge.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-auto-palette-follows-a-theme-switch
cases.purpose: The face-derived palette re-derives after an Emacs theme switch, so the preview follows the new theme instead of keeping the ink and surfaces of the theme that was active when it opened.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-reading-measure-stays-centered-on-refit
cases.purpose: Wide and narrow viewport refits keep the capped reading measure centered at its measured pixel position.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-heading-links-override-heading-color
cases.purpose: Links in all six heading levels retain accent color, heading weight and working activation without duplicate properties.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-video-caption-activates-player
cases.purpose: RET on a video caption starts inline playback when ffmpeg can decode it and never leaves the card to an external player.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-video-ret-toggles-playback-in-place
cases.purpose: RET on the live player pauses the canvas in place and resumes from the paused frame instead of restarting it.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-video-without-decoder-opens-externally
cases.purpose: A local video without ffmpeg keeps its poster card and opens in the desktop player instead of mounting a player, even after an earlier render cached its playback metadata.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-create-reports-document-state
cases.purpose: Creating a session from text exposes title, outline and footnotes.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-document-names-its-own-dialect
cases.purpose: 文档 front matter 里的 flavor: 行决定该文件用哪个方言解析；会话的 :flavor 参数优先，缺省用最宽的预设。

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-render-inline-styles-and-links
cases.purpose: A paragraph renders every run with its style and keeps links clickable.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-render-block-structure
cases.purpose: Headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code and tables all reach the buffer.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-footnotes-numbered-and-defined
cases.purpose: Footnote references render numbered and definitions appear at the end.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-media-cards-show-placeholders
cases.purpose: Missing local media renders a labeled card instead of failing.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-media-keeps-source-aspect-under-height-cap
cases.purpose: A media card capped by height narrows its grid instead of squashing the source.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-video-card-plays-with-a-native-decoder
cases.purpose: A local video renders as a poster card naming the inline play action when ffmpeg can decode it.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-local-media-opens-with-the-desktop
cases.purpose: RET on a local media card asks the desktop to open the file instead of loading it into Emacs.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-refresh-re-reads-a-file
cases.purpose: Refresh re-reads the file and publishes the new outline.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-unsaved-edits-reach-the-preview
cases.purpose: Editing the source buffer repaints the preview before it is saved, and closing the preview stops following the buffer.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-editing-beside-a-definition-list-repaints
cases.purpose: An unsaved edit repaints a document holding a definition list, where one paragraph and the list share a parse clause.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-entry-command-keeps-the-source-window
cases.purpose: The side-by-side command opens the preview in a neighbouring window, keeps the source buffer selected, and closing the preview gives the window back.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-follow-scroll-shows-the-source-top
cases.purpose: The scroll follow puts the block at the source window's top at the top of the page, and turning it off leaves the page alone.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-theme-switch-keeps-a-closed-source-whole
cases.purpose: A palette switch republishes the file when its source buffer is closed, keeping the page whole instead of publishing an empty document.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-breaks-follow-the-markdown-rules
cases.purpose: A soft break folds into one row, a two-space or backslash break and a blank line inside a fence paint their own rows, and blank lines between blocks keep their count.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-blank-lines-follow-the-source
cases.purpose: One blank source line paints one row between blocks, inside a loose list item, after a metadata line and after the front matter.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-saving-the-source-repaints-the-preview
cases.purpose: Saving a source file repaints its open preview without a manual reload and keeps the reader in the section it was reading.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-theme-changes-and-rejects-unknown
cases.purpose: Themes cycle in order and unknown palettes are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-auto-theme-keeps-the-emacs-background
cases.purpose: The auto theme paints no page background; an explicit palette paints its own.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-declares-its-surface-to-a-host
cases.purpose: A host frames the preview from the palette, theme cell and modes it declares, so a panel's title-bar switch repaints the document with the chosen page.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-auto-theme-derives-surfaces-from-faces
cases.purpose: The auto theme blends panel surfaces from the frame's own faces.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-custom-defaults-select-theme-flavor-and-bounds
cases.purpose: The theme, flavor and reading-measure defcustoms drive new sessions.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-locate-follows-the-outline
cases.purpose: Locate moves point to the heading band and next/previous walk the outline.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-close-releases-and-reopens
cases.purpose: Closing kills the buffer and the same session mounts again.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-front-matter-is-metadata
cases.purpose: Front matter is stripped from the body and feeds the title.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-flavor-commonmark-keeps-extensions-literal
cases.purpose: The CommonMark flavor leaves GFM-only syntax as literal text.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-flavor-gfm-converts-extensions
cases.purpose: The GFM flavor converts the extensions the previewer defaults to.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-flavor-rejects-unknown-name
cases.purpose: An unknown dialect name is reported instead of guessed.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-palette-paints-the-canvas
cases.purpose: Choosing each palette paints the cells the page does not cover with that palette's page background.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-file-opened-later-is-followed
cases.purpose: 先开预览、后打开 markdown 文件时，文件里的编辑（未保存）照样实时重画预览。

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-one-edit-repaints-one-block
cases.purpose: An unsaved edit in the source buffer repaints the block it changed: the published buffer patch covers that block's lines while the rest of a long document keeps its text, because every top-level block is published as its own Component.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-empty-block-paints-its-source-skeleton
cases.purpose: A heading, list item, quote, fence or table whose text is gone paints the markup its source still holds.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-empty-block-does-not-hide-a-full-table
cases.purpose: A table that still holds text paints its cells rather than its skeleton.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-front-matter-is-not-painted-as-blank-rows
cases.purpose: Front matter is shown as the document's title and subtitle, not as lines, so the page does not open with blank rows standing for it.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-metadata-line-keeps-the-blank-rows-around-it
cases.purpose: A line the parser consumes without a block, such as a link reference or abbreviation definition, still leaves the blank rows the file puts around it, so the next block is not pulled up against the previous one.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-pictures-fall-back-to-their-source
cases.purpose: With the drawing program turned off, a mermaid fence and a display formula still paint their source, so a page never depends on an external program.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-thematic-break-paints-a-rule
cases.purpose: A thematic break paints its horizontal rule instead of the dashes that wrote it, because a rule carries no text and must not be treated as an empty block.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-front-matter-labels-join-without-gaps
cases.purpose: A document whose front matter omits version and license shows its labels joined by one separator each, with no separator left standing for the missing value.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-definition-declares-both-attribute-tables
cases.purpose: A type definition stores its ordinary and derived attribute tables in the registry, and the inventory prints both plus the document spelling.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-second-definition-needs-extends-or-replace
cases.purpose: A second definition of an existing type is refused unless it says :extends or :replace, and :extends appends rather than redeclares.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-extends-refuses-a-second-declaration-of-one-name
cases.purpose: Extending a type with an attribute name it already declares is refused, because a name has one declaration.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-declaration-must-be-usable
cases.purpose: A declaration that names an unusable type, puts a default on a derived attribute, combines :required with :default, or uses :pattern off string is refused at load time.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-rule-set-is-replaced-per-selector
cases.purpose: A second rule set for the same selector replaces the first instead of stacking, and nil removes it.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-container-is-painted-by-its-definition
cases.purpose: A :::card and a :::columns with :::col children are parsed and painted by their definitions, with no failure line.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-container-with-no-definition-keeps-its-source
cases.purpose: A container whose name has no definition keeps its source on the page and reports one line naming the missing definition.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-user-definition-replaces-a-shipped-one
cases.purpose: A user definition with :replace changes how :::card paints; undefining it restores the shipped definition.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-block-that-breaks-its-declaration-shows-a-line
cases.purpose: A container missing a required attribute keeps its source and reports the missing attribute on the page.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-value-order-ends-at-the-shipped-default
cases.purpose: A style rule set to :default restores the declaration's shipped default, even when the document wrote a value.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-rule-that-names-no-attribute-is-reported
cases.purpose: A style rule naming an attribute the type does not declare is ignored, one line is reported, and the block still paints.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-tabs-draw-only-the-selected-page
cases.purpose: A tabs block writes one @tab marker per page, draws every label and only the selected page's body, with no failure line.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-marker-attribute-selects-a-page
cases.purpose: A selected=true attribute on an @tab marker opens that page, so the first page drawn is the author's choice.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-tab-keys-open-the-next-page
cases.purpose: TAB enters the tab strip, Right moves focus to the next tab and RET opens that page, so the keyboard changes the body instead of ringing.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-tab-body-keeps-a-marker-inside-a-fence
cases.purpose: An @tab line inside a fenced block in a tab body stays code and does not split the page.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-tab-body-can-hold-a-block-container
cases.purpose: A tab body can contain a :::note container, so a marker page is not limited to prose.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-marker-container-rejects-a-block-child
cases.purpose: A :::tab child inside a marker-written tabs container is reported as an error instead of being silently dropped.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-prose-before-the-first-marker-is-an-error
cases.purpose: Text before the first @tab marker is reported, so a tabs container cannot lose a paragraph.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-markers-mean-nothing-in-a-block-container
cases.purpose: An @tab line inside a note is ordinary text; the marker grammar applies only to the container that declares it.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-code-tabs-name-pages-by-fence-language
cases.purpose: A code-tabs page without a title is labelled by its fence language, and only the selected page's code is drawn.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-definition-declares-its-child-syntax
cases.purpose: A definition that declares marker children parses one @item per child, an extension keeps that grammar, and the block form is rejected in the same container.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-fenced-sample-cannot-open-a-container
cases.purpose: A code fence's sample container and its `:::' stay code, so the fence lines are not painted as text around a phantom container.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-fence-inside-a-container-does-not-close-it
cases.purpose: A `:::' line inside a fence in a container body does not close the container, and the sample's `:::' stays in the code block.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-the-site-components-paint
cases.purpose: A page using the whole site catalog mounts and paints every component's own text, plus the inline marks' text, without a failure line.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-command-card-follows-its-attribute
cases.purpose: A command card shows the package managers its attribute names and the rewritten command, without the attribute source leaking into the page.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-card-grid-lays-cards-side-by-side
cases.purpose: A two-column grid places both card titles on one painted row, which is the grid layout Plume writes as card-grid.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-folds-details-and-alignment-paint
cases.purpose: The later containers paint through one mount: info and danger callouts show their fixed titles, a details block starts closed, alignment containers keep their body, and the window's spacing attributes leave its content intact.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-child-boolean-set-to-false-is-off
cases.purpose: A child block's boolean attribute is read with its container's declaration: open=false stays closed while open=true shows its body.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-an-attribute-field-paints-its-metadata
cases.purpose: An attribute field paints its name, state chips, type, default, since, enum/unit/format/constraint notes and body, while the list form still paints name and value rows.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-panel-carries-its-title-on-the-edge
cases.purpose: 面板容器的标题、状态和正文都画出来，标题落在顶边那一行。

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-tab-panel-shows-one-page
cases.purpose: 标签页面板画出一行标签，只显示选中那一页的正文。

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-form-lines-up-labels-and-values
cases.purpose: 表单容器把每一行的名称与值按上下两行画出。

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-chat-groups-its-marked-messages
cases.purpose: A chat groups its blocks by {name}, {.} and {:date} markers, painting the name, date and words without the braces.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-steps-list-becomes-numbered-steps
cases.purpose: A steps container written as an ordered list paints every item's text as a numbered step.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-timeline-event-shows-its-status
cases.purpose: A timeline event with a status paints its title, time and that state's badge text.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-table-copies-itself-when-asked
cases.purpose: A table with copy=true paints a copy line; activating it puts the header and rows on the kill ring as tab separated text.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-doctor-names-each-optional-program
cases.purpose: `etaf-md-doctor` names every program a block can use — ffmpeg, mermaid-cli and qrencode — with a remedy, so a reader whose block kept its source text learns why.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-mailto-link-goes-to-the-browser
cases.purpose: A link whose scheme is not followed by `//`, such as `mailto:`, opens in the browser instead of being resolved against the document's directory and reported missing.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-a-link-to-a-document-opens-its-preview
cases.purpose: A relative link to another markdown file opens that file's preview at the heading its fragment names, instead of showing the document's raw source in a buffer.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-container-outline-keeps-document-order-and-locate
cases.purpose: Headings before, inside and after containers appear in `etaf-md-outline' in document order with unique anchor IDs, and `etaf-md-locate' and `#anchor' jumps land on them.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-container-footnotes-resolve-across-boundaries
cases.purpose: Footnote references before, inside and after containers are numbered in document order and resolve definitions written either inside or outside containers.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-headings-scale-with-level
cases.purpose: Front-matter titles and body headings of every level render larger than body text, with the document title the largest and all headings bold.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-on-link-intercepts-or-falls-back
cases.purpose: `:on-link' intercepts link activation (including container card links) when returning non-nil and falls back to browser or anchor navigation when returning nil.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-on-media-intercepts-or-falls-back
cases.purpose: `:on-media' receives `(KIND PATH)' (`image' or `video') on media press, intercepting activation on non-nil and falling back to default opening on nil.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-table-container-preserves-inline-runs
cases.purpose: `:::table' cells keep inline emphasis, code spans and clickable links instead of flattening cell content to plain text.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-columns-counts-explicit-tracks
cases.purpose: `:::columns' with an explicit track list counts columns from the parsed tracks (e.g. 3 tracks on one row, 1 track stacked) instead of falling back to 2.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-card-with-image-wraps-paragraph-inside-columns
cases.purpose: A `:::card' inside multi-column `:::columns' containing a block image followed by a long paragraph sizes its image to the card interior and wraps every word of the paragraph inside the card without clipping or changing column count.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-html-img-declared-dimensions-bound-render-size
cases.purpose: Raw HTML `' blocks declaring CSS pixel `width'/`height' render at their declared size (preserving natural aspect ratio for single-axis bounds, left-aligning compact icons without blank captions) rather than inflating to the underlying file's larger intrinsic pixel dimensions.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-link-hover-option-disables-mouse-face
cases.purpose: Passing `:link-hover nil' to `etaf-md-create' omits `mouse-face' hover highlights on rendered links while preserving hand pointer and `:on-link' activation.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-container-blocks-keep-blank-line-separation
cases.purpose: Multi-block containers (such as `:::details') render one blank line between adjacent paragraph, code and list child blocks instead of smashing them onto consecutive rows.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-svg-viewbox-preserves-aspect-and-caps-height
cases.purpose: SVGs declaring `viewBox' without explicit `width'/`height' attributes preserve their natural aspect ratio when sized by a single HTML `width' attribute (never collapsing into a square), and tall portrait figures cap row height while scaling width proportionally.

cases.name: etaf-md-tests-heading-underline-option-suppresses-heading-rules-and-link-underlines
cases.purpose: Passing `:heading-underline nil' to `etaf-md-create' omits H1/H2 bottom border rules and underlines on links inside headings while keeping heading links active and body paragraph links underlined.
